messages.subject: Discarded Observations
parts:
Hi Everyone

When I run
>mod45a<-occu(~1~log(CHA_FLOW_Z), umf)

I get 
>Warning messages:
1: In log(CHA_FLOW_Z) : NaNs produced
2: Some observations have been discarded because corresponding covariates were missing. 
3: 31 sites have been discarded because of missing data. 

I double checked the data and there are no missing covariate measures. 
The equation:

occu(~1~I(CHA_FLOW_Z^2), umf) 

works fine with the same dataset

I looked through the message boards and similar questions have been asked, but the solutions provided did not resolve my issue. Any suggestions?

Cheers and thank you

Adia
